On this walk you explore fortification, water systems and Sultanate city-scale planning.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Fort exterior/wall entry
  • Bastion view
  • Internal accessible ruins
  • Safe exit stop

How the time is spent

  1. Fort exterior/wall entry 20 min

    Explain Tughlaq military topography.

    You: map ridge lines

  2. Bastion view 50 min

    Study slopes, stone construction and defensive visibility.

    You: defence sketch

  3. Internal accessible ruins 45 min

    Relate city planning to water and landforms.

    You: evidence notes

  4. Safe exit stop 20 min

    Distinguish construction phases and contested stories.

    You: debate claim

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Tughlaqabad Fort using material evidence and a site map.
  • Explore fortification, water systems and Sultanate city-scale planning.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Tughlaqabad, Delhi
For
Schools, colleges, the public and private groups
Length

When
Any day you choose. Early morning is best in the warmer months.

Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Meeting point
Agreed with you. A map location is shared once the date is confirmed.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
